description: Validates an address for a chain and returns its canonical form. EVM: EIP-55 (a wrong checksum is refused, never corrected). Aptos: AIP-40 strict form. Says only what can be known offline; it never guesses what kind of account an address is.

chain.description: CAIP-2 chain id such as eip155:8453 (Base) or aptos:1; a bare EVM chain id number also works. Chain names like "base" are refused.

name: address_validate
title: Validate an address
